## Workflow B — Adaptive Nudge Delivery (Twilio)

### Delivery contract
- Polls every 5 minutes in Australia/Melbourne.
- Sends only approved generated schedule rows due in the current five-minute window.
- Calls the signed prepare-delivery endpoint first; it returns either the original text or one approved, rotated media resource.
- Uses one approved outbound Content Template with no progress or commitment buttons.
- Stores Twilio's Message SID and initial status in schedule_state.
- Supplies the Vercel /api/whatsapp-status callback so provider delivery states are recorded.

### Required environment variables
GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID, TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM, TWILIO_SEND_ONLY_CONTENT_SID, PORTAL_BASE_URL, N8N_PROXY_SECRET.

### Safety
The narrow delivery window prevents activation from flushing old rows. Typed STOP remains immediate; media selection never changes adherence state.
